name: s3Upload
syntax: s3Upload(bucket, object, source [, acl, location, accessKeyId, secretKey, host])
description: Uploads a local file to an S3 (or S3-compatible) bucket. The MIME type is auto-detected from the object key extension.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The name of the S3 bucket to upload to.

params.name: source
params.description: Path of the local file to upload.

params.name: acl
params.description: Object ACL to apply (accepted for compatibility; not enforced).

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: Upload a local file
examples.description: Reads the local file and stores it in the bucket.
